Privacy.Title: Privacy policy
Privacy.Subtitle: Data protection and privacy notice

Blocks.text: At houle.ai (West Bay SA), we are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data in accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP) and applicable EU regulations.
This privacy policy explains how we collect, use and protect your information when you use our AI services integrated into Microsoft tools.
West Bay SA (operating as houle.ai) acts as the data controller for personal data collected and processed in connection with our AI services.

Blocks.heading: Contact details:
lines: Address: Chemin du Pré-Roset 19, 1294 Genthod, Switzerland

Blocks.text: Service data:

items: Personal identification information (name, email address)
Microsoft account information for authentication
Document content processed through our AI services
Usage patterns and preferences for AI features
Technical data (IP address, browser type, device information)

Blocks.text: Website data:

items: Technical information (IP address, browser type, device information)
Usage data (pages visited, time spent, referral sources)
Cookies and similar tracking technologies
Contact form submissions and communications
How you found our website (first page visited, referring domain, campaign parameters and pages viewed during the visit), sent only with your message

Sections.Title: Web analytics and how you found us

Blocks.text: We measure the use of our website with Google Analytics 4 and Google Consent Mode. What is collected depends on your region and your choice in the cookie banner: in Switzerland analytics run unless you refuse, in the EU, the EEA and the UK nothing is stored before you accept. The cookies used and how to refuse are described in our cookies policy.

When you send a message through our contact form, we add how you reached our site: the first page you visited, the referring website (domain only), campaign parameters (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content), the Google Ads click identifier (gclid) if present, and up to 20 pages viewed during the visit. For this attribution we never keep full addresses or other URL parameters.

This information stays in your browser's memory during the visit (and, if you accepted cookies, in session storage, which is cleared when you close the tab). It is only sent with your message, through our form provider Formspark, and kept with it. We use it, on the basis of our legitimate interest, to understand which channels bring us enquiries.

Unless you refused analytics, we also add the Google Analytics identifier stored in your browser to a message you send us, to link it to our visit statistics. Refusing does not prevent you from contacting us.
We process your personal data based on the following legal grounds:

items: Contract performance: to provide AI services integrated into Microsoft tools
Legal compliance: to meet Swiss regulatory and reporting requirements
Legitimate interests: for business operations, fraud prevention and service improvement
Consent: for marketing communications and non-essential cookies (where required)

Blocks.text: Service delivery:

items: Providing AI assistance in Outlook, Word and other Microsoft tools
Processing and analysing documents for AI-powered features
Maintaining and improving AI models and services
Communicating about your services and account

items: Customer relationship management
Quality assurance and service improvement

Blocks.text: We may share your personal data with:

items: Microsoft Corporation (for authentication and integration services)

Blocks.text: We do not sell personal data to third parties. All sharing is conducted with appropriate confidentiality agreements and data protection measures in place.
We implement comprehensive security measures including:

items: Encryption of data in transit and at rest
Multi-factor authentication and access controls
Regular security assessments and updates
Staff training on data protection
Secure backup and disaster recovery procedures

Blocks.text: Data retention:

items: Service records: for the duration of your subscription plus legal retention requirements
Website data: for the duration necessary to fulfil the stated purposes
Marketing data: until consent is withdrawn or the data is no longer needed

Blocks.text: Under Swiss data protection law, you have the right to:

items.label: Access:
items.text: request information about personal data we hold about you

items.label: Rectification:
items.text: correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data

items.label: Erasure:
items.text: request deletion of personal data (subject to legal obligations)

items.label: Data portability:
items.text: receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format

items.label: Object:
items.text: object to processing based on legitimate interests

Blocks.text: To exercise these rights, contact us at contact@houle.ai. We will respond within 30 days.
We may transfer personal data outside Switzerland to:

items: EU/EEA countries with adequate data protection
Microsoft Azure data centres with appropriate safeguards
Third countries with appropriate safeguards (standard contractual clauses)

Blocks.text: All international transfers are conducted with appropriate legal safeguards to ensure your data remains protected to Swiss standards.
We may update this privacy policy to reflect changes in our practices, services or legal requirements. Material changes will be communicated through:

items: Email notification to registered users
A prominent notice on our website
Direct communication during service interactions

Blocks.text: The updated policy will be effective from the date specified in the revised version.

Cookies.MetaDescription: Information about our use of cookies and tracking technologies
Cookies.Title: Cookies policy
Cookies.Subtitle: Information about our use of cookies and tracking technologies

Blocks.text: This cookies policy explains how houle.ai (West Bay SA) uses cookies and similar tracking technologies on our website. It explains what cookies are, how we use them and your choices regarding their use.
Depending on where you are, some of these technologies run by default and others only with your consent. The section below explains what applies to you and how to refuse or change your choice.

We use Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Limited and Google LLC) with Google Consent Mode. The Google tag loads on every visit. What it may store depends on where you are, as estimated by Google from your IP address, and on your choice in the cookie banner. Like any Google Analytics setup, each measurement includes the address of the page viewed, with campaign parameters such as utm_source or gclid when they are in the link you followed.

items: Switzerland: analytics cookies (_ga, _ga_*) are used unless you click "Refuse". Advertising signals (advertising cookies, ad user data and ad personalisation) stay off until you click "Accept".

European Union, EEA and United Kingdom: no analytics or advertising cookies are set until you click "Accept". Until then the tag only sends cookieless measurement pings (for example a page view or a form sent), without an identifier that recognises you from one visit to the next. Google receives the technical data contained in any web request, such as your IP address and browser type, and uses these pings for aggregated statistics.
Other countries: analytics and advertising signals are on by default. You can turn them off with "Refuse".

Blocks.text: Google Tag Manager only loads after you click "Accept", wherever you are.

The cookie banner offers two choices. "Accept" allows analytics and advertising cookies and signals and Google Tag Manager. "Refuse" turns off analytics and advertising cookies and signals; the tag then only sends the cookieless pings described above. Your choice is saved in your browser (cookie and local storage entry "cookieConsent", 12 months) and you can change it at any time with the cookie button at the bottom of the page.

Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device (computer, tablet or mobile) when you visit a website. They allow the website to recognise your device and store information about your preferences or past actions.
Cookies typically contain:

items: The name of the server that placed the cookie
An identifier in the form of a unique number
An expiration date (some cookies only last for the duration of your session)

Blocks.text: 1. Essential cookies
These cookies are necessary for the website to function properly and cannot be disabled.

Blocks.heading: Purpose:
items: Website navigation and basic functionality
Security and authentication
Language and accessibility preferences
Form submission and session management

Blocks.text: 2. Analytics cookies
These cookies help us understand how visitors use our website (pages viewed, visit duration, traffic sources). The results are reported to us in aggregated form.

Blocks.heading: Purpose:
items: Website traffic analysis
Page performance monitoring
User behaviour patterns
Website optimisation and improvement

Blocks.text: 3. Functional cookies
These cookies enable enhanced functionality and personalisation features.

Blocks.heading: Purpose:
items: Remembering language and theme preferences
Saving form data and progress
Customising content and layout
Providing an enhanced user experience

Blocks.text: 4. Advertising signals
Google advertising signals measure the effectiveness of advertising. Where they apply by default and where they need your consent is explained in "How we measure visits" above.

Blocks.note: Provider: Google (advertising signals, Google Tag Manager)

Blocks.text: Cookies are classified by duration as follows:

items: Session cookies: temporary cookies that are deleted when you close your browser
Persistent cookies: remain on your device for a set period or until manually deleted

Blocks.text: Typical cookie lifespans:

items: Essential cookies: session duration or up to 1 year
Analytics cookies: 2 years maximum
Functional cookies: 1 year maximum

Blocks.text: Browser settings
You can control cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to:

items: View and delete cookies
Block cookies from specific websites
Block third-party cookies
Clear all cookies when you close the browser

Blocks.text: Impact of disabling cookies
Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect your experience on our website:

items: Essential cookies: the website may not function properly
Analytics cookies: we cannot improve our website based on usage data
Functional cookies: personalisation features will be disabled

Blocks.text: We retain cookie data for the limited period necessary for the purposes described in this policy.
We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes in technology, regulation or our practices. When we do, we will:

items: Update this page with the latest effective date
Notify users through our website (for significant changes)
Request renewed consent where required by law
